theme: An open Friday with a few decisions worth closing before the weekend.

needsAttention.title: Pathfinder drive-south window
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 5–18 gap to drive the Pathfinder from Portland to St. Pete closes Sunday. If it's still the plan, lock the dates and book the single hotel night.

needsAttention.title: December break destination
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 15 book-by slipped yesterday, and holiday inventory for six over three weeks is the thinnest of the year. The open call is domestic vs. international — passports land mid-November, so a domestic shortlist is the safe default.
